status: Carl 0.2 canonical six mono-Style baseline. Deck cards are unchanged from Revision 12; Leader rules are Revision 13.

decks.name: Bad Decisions
watchpoints: Does Florida Man create meaningful Sucker Punch decisions?
Is self-damage too easy to convert into upside?
Does Damage Everywhere matter without simply becoming burn?
decks.status_note: Revision 11 baseline; no card-list change from revision 10.

decks.name: Comeback Tour
mulligan_priority: Reply All, Reset the Vibes, or another refill bridge
watchpoints: Can the deck intentionally reach zero cards without making obviously bad plays?
Does Comeback Tour refill often enough to sustain Momentum without causing routine deck-out?
Do acceleration cards help create explosive turns rather than simply emptying the hand?
decks.status_note: Revision 12 baseline; Comeback Tour uses the start-of-Turn hand gate and low-hand tiered bodies.

decks.name: Now You See Me
mulligan_priority: Magician's Assistant, Rabbit, or Escape Artist
watchpoints: Does School Bully's Hothead let Misdirection convert replayed bodies into pressure without becoming oppressive?
Can Magician preserve its strong HOA matchup while remaining meaningfully weak into Rock Star and unfavored into Trash Baron?
Does Ace Up My Sleeve continue to feel useful without becoming the primary source of power?
Does Bounce remain a tempo engine rather than functioning as hard removal?
decks.status_note: Revision 11 baseline: School Bully gains Hothead; otherwise the revision-10 Magician list is unchanged.

decks.name: Curbside Empire
watchpoints: Is Jerry-Rig useful without becoming free permanent ramp?
Does Trash Baron create enough incentive to leave opposing Stash unspent?
Can Salvage reach Big Hand through scavenging rather than generic Draw?
decks.status_note: Revision 12 baseline; one Good as New added as Salvage Return counterplay.

decks.name: Violation Notice
mulligan_priority: Mall Walker or HOA Enforcement Committee
watchpoints: Does Failure to Respond create real urgency before Round 8 without making the endgame feel predetermined?
Can Stonewall survive long enough to threaten the deadline without simply stalling for its own sake?
Is Absolutely Not worth holding 3 Stash open?
decks.status_note: Revision 12 baseline; Absolutely Not is now a symmetric Rotated-board Return Action rather than a Response.

decks.name: Tag Team Trashfire
mulligan_priority: A cheap Wrestler or sacrifice body
Tag Me In! or a sacrifice payoff
watchpoints: How often does Stash-scaled Tag Out put a Character directly into play versus put the revealed card into hand?
Does Tag Out create exciting Hothead replacement attacks without excessive free-board snowballing?
Does recursion feel distinct from Salvage and self-damage distinct from Reckless?
decks.status_note: Revision 12 baseline; Stash-scaled Tag Out is the active Leader passive.
